dslRule:
<!id: information.presenter.fixed.width>
<!description: Set InformationPresenter to not resize width dynamically for the width dimension.>
<!severity: HINT>

org.eclipse.jface.text.information.InformationPresenter.setSizeConstraints($minWidth, $minHeight, true, $canResizeHeight)
=>
org.eclipse.jface.text.information.InformationPresenter.setSizeConstraints($minWidth, $minHeight, false, $canResizeHeight)
;;
summary: Updates InformationPresenter.setSizeConstraints to disable width resizing.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
